blocks.x: Can you remember how much money you were making with Seattle Harmony Kings?
Oh, I'd say - about $80.00 a week which is tremendous money in those days---

Because we were doing some recording and we were playing high class jobs; we had a lot of extra work. We were always doing some extra thing - we always had some little thing going - a private party -- in the afternoon, we'd play some afternoon things. And, such things. He always had us making extra money.
